erratum.note: Source erratum for K: the accepted product is the aldehyde hydrate, 2,2-dihydroxyacetic acid. The inherited alternative retains the aldehyde and forms a hypothetical orthoacid at the carboxyl group; it is not accepted for this reaction. Both have formula C₂H₄O₄ and Mr 92, so formula and mass alone do not distinguish them.
